info.name: Nocfinity E-commerce API
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for the Nocfinity Laravel API (P0-P7), covering all 65 routes.

## Quick start
1. Start the API: `php artisan serve --no-reload` (default `http://127.0.0.1:8001`).
2. Import this collection and `Nocfinity.local.postman_environment.json`.
3. Run **01 · Customer Auth → Login** and **02 · Staff Auth → Login**; tokens are captured automatically.
4. Run **03 · Catalog → List categories/products** to seed ids, then the cart and checkout flows.
5. Admin requests use `staffToken`; customer requests use `customerToken`. Admin routes also require the permission named in each request description.

## Conventions
- Money is always integer cents (USD).
- Every response uses `{ success, message, data, meta, errors }`; 204 responses have no body.
- Pagination lives in `meta.pagination`: `current_page, per_page, total, last_page`.
- The collection-level test asserts a 2xx status and the envelope shape.
- Create/list requests save ids to collection variables so update/delete requests chain without editing URLs.
- Destructive requests (delete) use the same variables: point them at disposable records before running.

## Stripe
Checkout requires real test keys in `backend/.env`. The webhook request signs its body with `stripeWebhookSecret` (set it to `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET`). For real payment events, use the Stripe CLI rather than manual webhook requests.

exec: pm.test("Envelope has the documented shape", function () {

item.name: 00 · Health
item.description: Liveness and dependency check. No authentication required.

request.description: Returns `status: ok` and database/cache booleans. Used by Docker/CI and uptime monitors.

item.name: 01 · Customer Auth
item.description: Customer registration, login, password reset and self-service. Login/register store the Sanctum bearer token in the `customerToken` collection variable.

request.description: Creates a customer account (201) and returns a bearer token. Password policy: min 8, mixed case, number and symbol. Unique email required.
Customer login. Five failures per email+IP return 429 with `Retry-After`. The token is saved to `customerToken`.
Always returns a generic success message, whether or not the email exists. In local development the reset link is written to Mailpit (`http://127.0.0.1:8025`).
Consumes the token from the reset email. Copy the token from Mailpit or `storage/logs/laravel.log`.
Current customer profile. Requires a customer-ability token.
Changes the password and revokes other sessions. After changing, update `customerPassword` or the Login request will fail.
Revokes the current customer token and clears `customerToken`.

item.name: 02 · Staff Auth
item.description: Staff login is a separate endpoint and issues a `staff` ability token. Admin endpoints reject customer tokens. Login stores `staffToken`.

request.description: Staff-only login. Seeds use `admin@nocfinity.test` / `SuperAdmin123!`. Customer accounts get the same generic 401.
Current staff profile with `roles` and the flattened `permissions` list used by the admin UI.
Changes the staff password and revokes other sessions.
Revokes the current staff token and clears `staffToken`.

item.name: 03 · Catalog (public)
item.description: Public catalog. Categories are returned as a tree; products support search, category subtree, price range, sorting and pagination. No authentication required.

request.description: Active category tree. Saves the first child category id (or the first root) to `categoryId`.

exec: const target = first.children && first.children.length ? first.children[0] : first;

query.description: Category slug; includes the whole subtree.

request.description: Paginated public catalog (inactive products and categories excluded). Saves the first result to `productId` and `productSlug`.
Product detail including gallery, stock status and up to four related products.

item.name: 04 · Cart
item.description: Guest or customer cart. Send `X-Cart-Token` for guests; customer tokens may be sent too. The server always recalculates prices. The cart token returned in `meta.cart_token` is saved automatically.

request.description: Resolves the current guest or customer cart, merges a stale guest cart for customers, and drops lapsed coupons.
Adds `productId` to the cart. Quantity is capped by stock and `cart.max_quantity_per_line`; exceeding the cap returns 422.

exec: const line = items.find(function (item) { return item.product_id === productId; }) || items[items.length - 1];

request.description: Sets an absolute quantity (1-1000, then stock/cap checked by the service). Other customers' item ids return 404.

exec: const line = items.find(function (item) { return item.product_id === productId; }) || items[items.length - 1];

request.description: Validates and applies a coupon code. Throttled (`coupon` limiter). Seeded codes: `WELCOME10` (10%), `SAVE20` ($20), `EXPIRED10` (always fails).
Detaches the active coupon from the cart.
Removes one line (204). Removing the last line also detaches the coupon.
Removes every line and the coupon (204).

item.name: 05 · Checkout & Orders
item.description: Authenticated customer checkout. Prices, stock and totals come from the server-side cart. Send `Idempotency-Key` on every checkout attempt so retries return the same order.

request.description: Creates a pending order and a Stripe PaymentIntent. Returns `data.payment.client_secret` for Stripe Elements. Requires real Stripe test keys in `backend/.env`. Saves the order id to `orderId`.
Paginated orders for the authenticated customer only. Saves the first order id.
Order detail with items and payment status. Another customer's order id returns 404.

item.name: 06 · Admin · Dashboard & Orders
item.description: Admin reporting and order management. Every route requires a staff token plus the permission named in the request description.

request.description: Permission: `reports.view`. Today's orders/revenue, customer count, low-stock count, 30-day series and recent orders.

query.description: pending | paid | processing | shipped | delivered | cancelled
Order number, customer name or email.

request.description: Permission: `orders.view`. Saves the first order id.
Permission: `orders.view`. Includes items, payment status, status history and `valid_transitions`.
Permissions: `orders.update_status` (and `orders.cancel` when moving to cancelled). `paid` is rejected — only the Stripe webhook marks an order paid. Use `valid_transitions` from the detail response.

item.name: 07 · Admin · Catalog
item.description: Category, product and image administration. Category/product create requests save the new id so the update/delete requests can run immediately afterwards.

request.description: Permission: `categories.manage`. Full tree including inactive categories. Saves the first id.

Permission: `categories.manage`.
Permission: `categories.manage`. Partial update.
Permission: `categories.manage`. Soft deletes (204). Point `categoryId` at a disposable record before running.

request.description: Permission: `products.create`. Prices are integer cents. `discount_price` must be lower than `price`. Saves the new id and slug.
Permission: `products.view`. Admin detail by numeric id.
Permission: `products.edit`. Partial update.
Permission: `products.delete`. Soft deletes the product and removes its image files (204). Point `productId` at a disposable record.
Permission: `products.edit`. Multipart upload: jpg/jpeg/png/webp, max 2 MB. Pick a file in the request body; saves the new image id.
Permission: `products.edit`. Updates alt text, primary flag or sort order.
Permission: `products.edit`. Send every image id for the product in the desired order. The id below is injected unquoted so it stays an integer.
Permission: `products.edit`. Deletes the file and row (204).

item.name: 08 · Admin · Coupons
item.description: Coupon administration. All routes require `coupons.manage`. Coupon codes are trimmed and uppercased; percentage value cannot exceed 100. PATCH expects the full coupon representation.

request.description: Permission: `coupons.manage`. Saves the first coupon id and code.
Permission: `coupons.manage`. `value` is a percentage (1-100) or fixed amount in cents. Saves the new id and code.
Permission: `coupons.manage`.
Permission: `coupons.manage`. Full representation: code, type and value are required. The current code is injected from `couponCode`.
Permission: `coupons.manage`. Soft deletes (204).

item.name: 09 · Admin · Customers & Activity
item.description: Read-only customer views and the audit log.

request.description: Permission: `customers.view`. Customer accounts only (staff never appear). Saves the first id.
Permission: `customers.view`. Includes lifetime spend and the customer's orders. A staff id returns 404.
Permission: `roles.manage`. Newest first. Logging is best-effort and never blocks the write it describes.

item.name: 10 · Admin · Roles & Permissions
item.description: RBAC administration. All routes require `roles.manage`. Permission names are fixed by the server registry; a role create/update must use names from `GET /admin/permissions`.

request.description: Permission: `roles.manage`. Grouped permission registry used to render the matrix.
Permission: `roles.manage`. Saves the first role id and name.
Permission: `roles.manage`. `permissions` is required (may be empty). Saves the new id and name.
Permission: `roles.manage`. Includes permissions and staff count.
Permission: `roles.manage`. The current name is injected from `roleName`.
Permission: `roles.manage` (204). System roles and roles with staff cannot be deleted.

item.name: 11 · Admin · Staff
item.description: Staff account administration. All routes require `staff.manage`. Deleting a staff member deactivates the account and revokes its tokens.

request.description: Permission: `staff.manage`. Saves the first staff id.
Permission: `staff.manage`. Password follows the shared policy; roles must exist. Saves the new staff id.
Permission: `staff.manage`. Includes roles and flattened permissions.
Permission: `staff.manage`. Partial update; roles replace the current set.
Permission: `staff.manage`. Deactivates the account, revokes tokens and returns 204. You cannot deactivate yourself.

item.name: 12 · Admin · Profile
item.description: Staff self-service profile. No extra permission beyond a staff token is required.

request.description: Current staff profile.
Updates name, phone or email. Changing the email clears `email_verified_at` and revokes other sessions.

item.name: 13 · Webhooks
item.description: Stripe webhook receiver. The signature is verified before the payload is parsed. The pre-request script signs the exact body with `stripeWebhookSecret`.

request.description: No bearer token. Set `stripeWebhookSecret` to the same value as `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET` in `backend/.env`. This example sends a harmless `customer.created` event; use the Stripe CLI (`stripe listen --forward-to 127.0.0.1:8001/api/v1/webhooks/stripe`) for real payment events.

exec: console.warn("Set stripeWebhookSecret to your STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET before sending.");
